logging/file#

Log files: appended to, flushed or synced as told, reopened after outside rotation.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let file = LogFile(path: Path("app.log"), options: FileLogOptions(permissions: PermissionMode(0o640), flush_each: true, sync_each: false));
Logger(name: "shop", destination: TextStreamLogs(file));

Description#

Log files: appended to, flushed or synced as told, reopened after outside rotation.

object LogFileState#

object LogFileState does Writing, Closing

Shared internal state for plain and rotating owners. No public stream view exposes the descriptor. Every operation is non-suspending; native append is a single attempt, and IncompleteWrite retains the exact consumed prefix.
